QUOTE: "Approved if either: ... `ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` matches the allow list (server_manager.cpp:286)." and "deny wins over both the allow list and auto-approve."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer puts the allow list in the approval gate and says deny still wins. It never says the allow list is consulted only from `check_approval`, and it adds that "Allow patterns are checked in `is_allowed`", which blurs that claim.
